title: Juicy Smoky Indian Galangal Vada Pav
description: A smoky and fluffy Indian dish featuring galangal, perfect for a midnight craving, this satvik-friendly vada pav is a must try. It combines the flavors of galangal and spices with a crispy exterior and a soft interior.
instructions: Grate the galangal and soak it in ice water for 30 minutes to remove excess heat.
Drain the galangal and mix it with mashed potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Add gram flour, yogurt, and spices to the mixture and mix well.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a round patty.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry the patties until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the patties on paper towels and serve them in bread buns.
Toast the bread buns on a pan or in a toaster before serving.
Assemble the vada pav by placing a patty in each bread bun and serving immediately.
